content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission would not correct the authorization defect, and billing the patient for this provider-liability denial would exceed the contractual patient share. A formal appeal supported by the existing clinical documentation is the only available payer-level path to seek coverage."}
